topic.title: Why Support and Resistance Are Zones, Not Magic Lines

research.summary: Markets often react around price areas, not a single exact number. Look for repeated reactions, failed breaks, and context from the higher timeframe. A zone can help organize your analysis, but it is never a guaranteed floor or ceiling. The real skill is reading what price does when it reaches the area.
